scope: Visual-only artifacts; local author review, coordinator acceptance separate
overviewCoverage: All fifteen three-device boards inspected for composition and reflow; not pixel-by-pixel review of all 45 files

findings.finding: Search and task access precede the compact model feature; electronics remain distinct without decorative brand/color/imagery.
Desktop four-column spec cards change to two tablet columns and compact mobile rows; product images are contained.
CG-7 and CG-5 identity, shape, data rates and port counts remain distinguishable. Unknown device compatibility remains unconfirmed.
Native-width mobile table/detail captures show wrapped readable rows, explicit missing pass-through, normalized Mb/s and mm units without horizontal page scrolling.
Mobile/tablet review shows both model lines and full total before the payment action; mock-provider and error/retry state are explicit.
Owned order lines are immutable references with correct totals; address edit shows preserved invalid PIN, inline explanation and visible save/cancel.
Profile badge now Signed in in source and all3 fresh PNGs; no email verification is implied. 320px correction check passes; other42 PNG hashes preserved.
Canonical identity uses current brand-ink semantics and actual BuyerAuthorize explicit Continue state, no mandatory email-code/link or consent checkbox fiction.

limitations: Tall full-page images may be resized by the viewing tool; native-width element captures were opened for critical technical tables
